title: Automated medical microscope under NDA
summary: Development and deployment of an automated microscope for analysing medical samples during the COVID-19 crisis, while details concerning the samples and their precise medical use remain confidential.

facts.label: Confidentiality
facts.value: Sample type and precise medical purpose covered by NDA

paragraphs: This technical consulting assignment was carried out for Vidya Health Ltd during the COVID-19 crisis.
The project concerned an automated epifluorescence microscope used to analyse medical samples.
The type of sample analysed and the precise medical purpose of the device are covered by a confidentiality agreement.

The physical construction of the microscope followed the project manager’s specifications. My contribution focused primarily on the autofocus system and the software required to operate the instrument.
I proposed the autofocus algorithm, drafted the technical specifications and developed the control software using LabVIEW.
I integrated and deployed the software on the prototype, produced the technical and user documentation and trained the users.
